close_reason: Created tests/helpers.rs and tests/calendar_smoke_tests.rs (3 smoke tests: calendar get, event set, event parse notParsable); clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-calendars-client/tests/smoke_integration.rs plus tests/parse_integration.rs. 7 async wiremock tests covering existing and new methods. Oracle: §8.1 (Calendar/get), §8.2 (CalendarEvent/set create), §8.5 Figures 18-21 (CalendarEvent/parse).

**Tests (smoke_integration.rs):**
1. calendar_get_round_trip: mock returns §8.1 Calendar response fixture; assert account_id and list length.
2. calendar_event_set_create_round_trip: mock returns §8.2 SetResponse; assert created map has expected key.
3. calendar_get_request_method_name: capture request; assert methodCalls[0][0]=="Calendar/get" and using contains "urn:ietf:params:jmap:calendars".

**Tests (parse_integration.rs):**
4. parse_success: mock returns §8.5 Figure 19; assert parsed map has one entry, not_found is None.
5. parse_not_found: mock returns Figure 20; assert not_found has one id.
6. parse_not_parsable: mock returns Figure 21; assert not_parsable has one id.
7. parse_request_shape: capture request; assert methodCalls[0][0]=="CalendarEvent/parse" and blobIds key present.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 7 tests pass. Fixtures from spec §8.1, §8.2, §8.5 verbatim.
title: Wiremock smoke tests: Calendar/get, CalendarEvent/set, CalendarEvent/parse
